answer: A payout is split and as a result 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The basalt schedule is applied in lagoon and delta makes public each instalment. An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3535 identities would post 3377 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
